COVENANT DEFINITION — locked 2026-08-12, Stage 16.5, file 00r-what-is-a-covenant.md (commit cba470e).

berit (Hebrew) / diatheke (Greek). A covenant = a solemn, binding RELATIONSHIP established by commitments or promises — parties, obligations, signs, blessings, consequences, sometimes oath or sacrifice. Idiom: one CUTS a covenant (karat berit), tying covenant to sacrifice at vocabulary level (Gen 15's divided animals).

CORE DISTINCTION: THE COVENANT IS NOT IDENTICAL TO THE COMMANDMENTS ASSOCIATED WITH IT. A covenant contains obligations; obligations are not its definition.

SEVEN TERMS HELD APART (conflating = Category Collapse): COVENANT (the relational arrangement) / PROMISE (what Yahweh commits to accomplish) / COMMANDMENT (what Yahweh commands) / COVENANT OBLIGATION-STIPULATION (what a particular arrangement requires) / COVENANT SIGN (visible marker) / COVENANT BLESSING / COVENANT CURSE.

SHARPENING: covenant != promise. A covenant contains promises but is more relational and structured. EVERY COVENANT INVOLVES COMMITMENTS; NOT EVERY PROMISE IS A COVENANT.

'SHABBAT IS THE COVENANT' IS IMPRECISE — Shabbat is named a covenant SIGN (Ex 31:17), as are the rainbow (Gen 9:12-13) and circumcision (Gen 17:11). NOTE FOR THE LATER SHABBAT STAGE, DELIBERATELY NOT CASHED: Ex 31:17 roots Shabbat in CREATION, not only Sinai.

EIGHT STRUCTURAL QUESTIONS for any covenant: parties / relationship established / Yahweh's promise / required response / sign / blessings-curses / duration / purpose in the developing story.

MAJOR FINDING THE SIDEBAR PRODUCED: BERIT OLAM attaches to THREE institutions — RAINBOW (Gen 9:16), CIRCUMCISION (Gen 17:13), SHABBAT (Ex 31:16). Same Hebrew phrase. NO tradition treats all three identically: nobody says the rainbow covenant ended; the apostles didn't require circumcision of Gentiles; Shabbat is contested. This STRENGTHENS the OLAM brake, does not relieve it — the phrase alone cannot settle any case. EXPLICITLY DOES NOT MEAN olam = 'temporary' (that's the Anti-Replacement error, swapping one rigid reading for its opposite). It means olam is NOT the load-bearing word everyone assumes. Removes the temptation to treat one lexical verdict as decisive for circumcision + Shabbat + Ezekiel 37's sanctuary simultaneously.
TRANSLATION INCONSISTENCY: ESV renders the identical phrase 'everlasting covenant' (Gen 9:16, 17:13) but 'covenant forever' (Ex 31:16). CJB: 'perpetual' at Ex 31:16, 'everlasting' at Gen 17:13. RVR1960 most consistent: 'perpetuo' both places.

NEW FORMAL RULE — THE COVENANT RELATIONSHIP RULE (now in 00b + 00-methodology-current as rule 5): LATER COVENANT != AUTOMATIC CANCELLATION of preceding covenants. EARLIER COVENANT != every feature retaining identical administration forever. SCRIPTURE MUST TELL US THE RELATIONSHIP; NEVER INFERRED FROM SEQUENCE ALONE. Decisive test case = THE RAINBOW, precisely because it's uncontroversial: nobody argues circumcision replaced the rainbow covenant, and the ONLY reason is that Scripture never says so. WARRANT: Galatians 3:17 — the law 'came 430 years afterward, does not annul a covenant previously ratified by God.' Paul himself reasons that later covenantal/legal development does not automatically nullify an earlier divine promise.

'ADDENDUM' INTUITION MODIFIED NOT REJECTED: addendum implies terms appended to one unchanged contract. The biblical form is Gal 3:17 — a claim about PROMISES NOT BEING ANNULLED. Covenant sequence: Noah (rainbow) -> Abraham (circumcision) -> Sinai (Torah/priesthood/sanctuary/sacrifice) -> David (house/throne/kingdom) -> New (Jer 31). Noah wasn't a failed first attempt; Sinai isn't 'Abraham 2.0'; David doesn't erase Abraham. Story becomes MORE SPECIFIC, concentrating toward Messiah. BUT Jeremiah adds what accumulation alone can't hold: a covenant genuinely BROKEN — yet Yahweh does NOT say everything prior is canceled. Continuity and discontinuity both preserved; neither half swallows the other. The Stage 15 refinement SURVIVES and is strengthened: 'one covenantal story containing multiple covenants, culminating in Messiah.'

TWO CJB TRANSLATION DATA RECORDED NOT ADOPTED: (1) diatheke rendered 'oath' at Gal 3:17 — interpretive, Greek is not horkos; (2) CJB inserts 'the legal part of the Torah' twice where ESV/RVR1960 read simply 'the law' — importing the very moral/civil/ceremonial-style partition that Category Collapse's SECOND FACE flags as theological taxonomy rather than biblical terminology.

REFRAMES STAGE 17 RETROACTIVELY: the circumcision question is NOT 'did Yahweh repeal a rule?' but 'WHAT HAPPENED TO THE SIGN'S COVENANTAL BOUNDARY-MARKER FUNCTION?' — which is why 00q section 20's classification produced NO row reading 'abolished'; every row describes a CHANGE IN FUNCTION.

READ 00-methodology-current.md FIRST. ADR-0009 THREE PROVENANCE LAYERS IN FORCE — classify every tranche as Main Argument / Manuscript Voice / RESEARCHER'S COMMENTARY (may be more than one). PRESERVE EVERYTHING NOW, CURATE LATER.

STAGE 18.9 = 00u sections 19-29 (the Numbers 6 branch flagged at 18.8, TAKEN IMMEDIATELY rather than deferred).
GOVERNING DISCIPLINE: Numbers 6 defines Numbers 6 BEFORE Acts, Paul, or Hebrews tells us what we want it to mean.

- NAZIRITE VOW IS NOT FUNDAMENTALLY A PUNISHMENT FOR SIN — voluntary period of SPECIAL CONSECRATION (nazir = 'one separated'). Structure: vow -> separation -> holiness -> completion. Num 6:3-6 restrictions: no grapevine products, no razor, no corpse contact.
- Num 6:2 'either a man or a woman' — RECORDED AS OBSERVATION ONLY, NOTHING EXTRACTED. Does not settle later questions about teaching authority/office; forcing unrelated questions together is what this project agreed not to do.

*** NUMBERS 6:9-12 IS WHERE THE ENGLISH CATEGORY BREAKS *** A man does nothing but stand near someone who dies suddenly. He owes a CHATTAT (6:11) AND an ASHAM (6:12), and the text says the priest makes atonement 'BECAUSE HE SINNED BY REASON OF THE DEAD BODY' (CJB 'inasmuch as he sinned because of the dead person'). BOTH HALVES RECORDED: ESTABLISHED = the category is BROADER than deliberate moral transgression (covers involuntary corpse contact), which is why chattat is often explained as a PURIFICATION offering. NOT ESTABLISHED = that chattat carries NO sin-content at all — THE TEXT DOES USE SIN-LANGUAGE AND WE ARE NOT ENTITLED TO RELABEL IT 'PURIFICATION' AND MOVE ON BECAUSE IT RESOLVES A DIFFICULTY FOR US. Open q 46.

- NORMAL COMPLETION (6:14) ALSO INCLUDES A CHATTAT (plus burnt, peace, grain, drink, wave). So Acts 21 CANNOT be resolved as 'a harmless thanksgiving/vow sacrifice'. RESISTANCE FOUND IN THE EVIDENCE, NOT AROUND IT.
- BUT Numbers 6 BLOCKS THE OPPOSITE SIMPLIFICATION EQUALLY: 'a sin offering was involved, therefore Paul thought Messiah insufficient' IMPOSES A THEOLOGICAL DEFINITION NUMBERS DOESN'T GIVE. The rite belongs to a system of consecration/purity/sanctuary access/vow completion/fellowship/worship. 'Please provide eternal redemption because Messiah failed' is OUR category, not Numbers 6's sentence.

*** CORRECTION — 'PAY THEIR EXPENSES' KILLS THE THEATER READING *** Numbers 6 requires multiple animals + bread + grain + drink offerings, FOR FOUR MEN. Paul MATERIALLY FINANCES the completion of their vows. DOWNGRADED (this project's OWN earlier framing from 18.8 section 5): 'Paul performed an obsolete Jewish ritual merely to appease Torah-observant believers' — THAT MAKES THE DEMONSTRATION DECEPTIVE, when James's entire stated point is that it demonstrates something TRUE. REPLACED WITH: Paul considered this Jewish Torah practice GENUINELY PERMISSIBLE FOR HIMSELF, while simultaneously denying that such practices justified anyone, grounded salvation, or had to be imposed on Gentiles. Still hypothesis — but stronger, and DOESN'T REQUIRE PAUL TO BE PERFORMING. 1 Cor 9 remains relevant but Acts 21 is stronger than 'I'll pretend to follow your customs'.

- THE PRECISION BELONGS TO US, NOT TO HEBREWS. If Hebrews meant 'any post-crucifixion Temple sacrifice denies Messiah', Acts 21 is very difficult. Heb 10:14 ('perfected for all time those who are being sanctified'; CJB 'brought to the goal') claims what MESSIAH UNIQUELY ACCOMPLISHES — it does NOT follow that every Temple rite became intrinsically sinful the moment Yeshua died. That proposition needs its own evidence; Acts 21 pressures it.
- THE BETTER MODEL WITH CONFIDENCE LABELS EXPLICITLY NOT COLLAPSED: (1) Levitical sacrifices genuinely performed the temporal/covenantal/purificatory functions Yahweh assigned = STRONGLY SCRIPTURAL. (2) They patterned realities they could never finally accomplish = STRONGLY SCRIPTURAL. (3) Messiah accomplishes the ultimate reality once for all = STRONGLY SCRIPTURAL. (4) Jewish believers continue some Temple practices while the Temple stands = HISTORICAL NARRATIVE IN ACTS. (5) Those rites continued as NON-RIVAL covenantal/purificatory practices = OUR EXPLANATORY HYPOTHESIS. (6) AD 70's theological significance = UNINVESTIGATED. THE CHAIN READS AS A SINGLE ARGUMENT AND IS NOT ONE.

*** AD 70 REACHED FROM A SECOND, NON-PROPHETIC DIRECTION (open q 45) *** Until now approached only via Matthew 24 / 'this generation' / cosmic judgment language / preterist chronology. NEW QUESTION: could the Temple's destruction represent the HISTORICAL TERMINATION OF AN ALREADY-SURPASSED SACRIFICIAL ADMINISTRATION? HYPOTHESIS ONLY — HEBREWS NEVER SAYS 'UNTIL AD 70', ACTS NEVER SAYS 'LEGITIMATE UNTIL ROME DESTROYS IT'. NEITHER TEXT SUPPLIES THE TERMINUS. Striking sequence: Messiah's sacrifice -> apostolic proclamation -> Jewish believers still using Temple (Acts 21:26) -> Hebrews develops superior priesthood/sacrifice -> Temple destroyed. RECORDED BECAUSE TWO INDEPENDENT INVESTIGATIVE LINES CONVERGING ON THE SAME EVENT IS ITSELF A DATUM, and it gives the eventual Matthew 24 return a second line of approach.

*** NEW RULE — THE COLLAPSED-EXPLANATION DIAGNOSTIC (00b) *** WHEN A CONVENIENT EXPLANATION COLLAPSES, CHECK WHETHER IT COLLAPSED BECAUSE ONE OF YOUR CATEGORIES WAS TOO SMALL — BEFORE CONCLUDING THE EVIDENCE CONFLICTS. Observed TWICE in one investigation: (a) 'Paul participated only in a non-atoning vow offering' collapsed by Num 6:14, exposing that 'SACRIFICE' had been flattened into one category; (b) '"sin offering" = Messiah's once-for-all removal of sin' collapsed by Num 6:9-12, exposing that 'SIN OFFERING' had been equated with modern personal moral guilt. IN BOTH CASES THE ATTEMPTED ANSWER WAS MORE USEFUL FAILING THAN SUCCEEDING, BECAUSE WHAT IT EXPOSED WAS LARGER THAN WHAT IT WOULD HAVE SOLVED. A failed explanation is a DIAGNOSTIC INSTRUMENT, not a dead end. This is partly why ADR-0009's Researcher's Commentary layer exists.

KEY MANUSCRIPT VOICE LINE: 'A Nazirite could complete his vow faithfully, having broken nothing — and still bring a sin offering. Another could have a man die beside him in the street, through no fault at all, and Torah would say he sinned by reason of the dead body. I HAD BEEN READING MY OWN VOCABULARY BACK INTO YAHWEH'S.'

*** IMPORTANT ORDER NOTE FOR NEXT STAGE *** SHADOW -> REALITY WAS ARRIVED AT INDEPENDENTLY through Leviticus, Acts, and Hebrews — NOT manufactured to explain Colossians 2. That makes the next question available in a far more sophisticated form: DOES FULFILLMENT OF A SHADOW MEAN THE SHADOW BECOMES FALSE, SINFUL, UNNECESSARY, TRANSFORMED — OR SOMETHING ELSE ENTIRELY?
